    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.123.0...0.123.1">0.123.1</a> (2026-09-18)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>bedrock:</strong> refresh auth across HTTP adapters (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10123" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10123/hovercard">#10123</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/9d3f063815568afc77786966e1096aec01e53177">9d3f063</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add Gemini 3.8 and Vertex Live (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10956" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10956/hovercard">#10956</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/1417f22b60f1268bb4bf8ead4df271853be6c512">1417f22</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add GPT-Live voice sessions (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10891" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10891/hovercard">#10891</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/316a3341fe69c59c55bc835964ab588d27b844a3">316a334</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add OpenAI Agents API (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10892" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10892/hovercard">#10892</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/ad3bee3299e3a9864ef6d47482298b2e7f1ceb37">ad3bee3</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add portable HTTP config schemas (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10968" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10968/hovercard">#10968</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/fcd06045caab8ea338d6eab4655d07e656ff883f">fcd0604</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add portable MCP config schemas (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10965" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10965/hovercard">#10965</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/f5ccb3c8e8bb14a254bc95073b174739485ac054">f5ccb3c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> support Ollama 0.34 features and refresh model docs (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10964" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10964/hovercard">#10964</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/ac01a4fe9f8cb265ff8dcaebefcb3854bb5fa065">ac01a4f</a>)</li>
